description: Source code for handling file uploads in Mattermost server API, including creating upload sessions, retrieving upload info, and uploading data.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API class with method InitUpload for setting up upload routes.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context class used for handling request context, permissions, and errors.

methods.name: InitUpload
methods.description: Initializes upload-related routes for handling upload creation, retrieval, and data upload.

methods.name: createUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload session after validating permissions and configuration.

methods.description: Retrieves information about an existing upload session.

methods.name: uploadData

methods.name: doUploadData
methods.description: Performs the actual upload of data, parsing multipart headers if necessary.
